title: regole_tp/3: the rules of transformation of a parent, in profiles
description: File TP_Mine/data/regole_tp_3.json, read by crates/mzlab-feat/src/hypo/rules.rs. A rule is a signed change of formula with the class of its mechanism, the retention-time direction expected in reversed phase, the level of the prediction (2 literature, 3 class, 4 generic) and preconditions on the elements and on the functional groups of the parent. The functional groups come from the SMILES of the parent (crates/mzlab-feat/src/chem/graph.rs, names in docs/agenti/mzfeat-tp.md): a rule with groups is used only when the structure is known; a rule with `fallback` only when it is not. Older versions (`regole_tp/1`, `/2`: Italian keys) are refused with `error.hypo.rulesVersion`, never converted; the registry of the hypotheses (`ipotesi/1`, field `rules_version`) says which version made it.

default_profile.description: name of the profile used when none is asked for

profiles.description: profiles by name: `photocatalysis` (TiO2/UV), `ozone_chlorine` (frozen until there are data), `metabolism_I_II`

frozen.description: true: the profile has no rules yet and asking for it is an error (error.hypo.profileFrozen)

inherits.description: name of a profile whose rules come first (one level)

id.description: label of the rule in the hypotheses; ids of a profile are distinct. On the same change of formula the first rule of the file gives the label and the level

class.description: mechanistic class; the id when absent

max_steps.description: times the rule may repeat in one path

fallback.description: used only when the structure of the parent is not known

all.description: elements the parent must have, with the least count

any.description: at least one of these elements

groups_any.description: at least one of these functional groups
